claims.evidence: Witness report shows a Yamaha PSR-style keyboard with LCD and controls, but does not confirm power-on, sound output, or full functionality.

claims.claim: It is used but working perfectly well.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include condition checks (scratches, speaker grille wear, loose/missing keys) or a functional test.
Witness report indicates Yamaha PSR with model text not fully readable; it does not confirm PSR-175 vs PSR-275.

risks.risk: Unconfirmed working condition (may have dead keys, faulty buttons, weak/one-side speaker, or LCD/sound issues).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, LCD lights up, playing several keys across the range, and pressing multiple buttons/tones with audible output from both left and right speakers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly needing repair (worst-case working uncertainty).

risks.risk: Model mismatch (PSR-175 vs PSR-275) affects value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the exact model number label on the control panel and/or the back/bottom nameplate showing the full PSR model.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower-value/less certain variant until the exact model is readable.

risks.risk: Missing or faulty power adapter (keyboard may not run without the correct adapter).
risks.proof: Photo of the included adapter (label showing voltage/amp) and a clip showing it powering the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming adapter may be missing or not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Accessories not included (stand, sustain pedal, manuals, original box) reducing usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo inventory of everything included: sustain pedal, power adapter, any stand, manuals, and box (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming accessories are included.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (scratches, cracks, loose keys, damaged speaker grilles) not fully assessed by the witness.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: speaker grilles (both sides), keybed area, and corners/edges; plus a quick shake/fit check of keys.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic wear/possible minor damage.

risks.risk: LCD/display problems (dead pixels, dim screen) that may still allow sound but reduce usability.
risks.proof: Video showing the LCD during operation (changing screens/menus) and a clear view of the display.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially having display issues.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the exact model number (PSR-175 or PSR-275) from the control panel text and the back/bottom nameplate.
Video: power-on showing LCD, then playing keys across the full range with audible sound from both speakers.
Video or photo confirming the power adapter is included and matches the keyboard requirements; show it powering the unit.
Photos of included accessories (sustain pedal, stand, manuals/box if any).
Close-up photos of speaker grilles, key tops, and corners/edges to assess cracks/loose keys/wear.
response.reason: The witness confirms it appears to be a Yamaha PSR keyboard with an LCD and speakers, but the key details needed to price it safely in Oyo (exact model, fully working test, adapter/accessories, and condition) are not shown. Request proof before pricing.
